findings.detail: Repeats earlier question M2-S54-T1. The stem is nearly the same: a Pydantic validation loop that retries failures with the specific validation errors appended. Option D gives the same answer: retry format mismatches and skip retries when the value is absent from the source. The new question only recasts the two failure groups as a general rule under cost pressure, so the scene and the answer are essentially the same.

blind_answer.reason: Retries with error feedback can fix format and structural mismatches, but they cannot help when the required information is absent from the source document (4.4-K2, 4.4-S2). Option A is wrong because tool use already eliminates JSON syntax errors, and semantic errors can benefit from a retry. Option B is wrong because it splits on required vs optional fields, which says nothing about whether a retry can succeed. Option C is wrong because low confidence does not show the value exists in the document.
